claim_text: The Operators (src/yanantin/apacheta/operators/)** I saw: - `bootstrap.py` — likely creates initial tensors - `compose.py` — combines tensors   - `correct.py` — corrects tensors (mentioned in multiple scouts) - `dissent.py` — allows disagreement - `evolve.py` — tensor evolution - `negate.py` — negation - `project.py` — projection These operators seem to be the *verbs* of the tensor system—how tensors interact, correct, compose.
